evidence.excerpt: We’re beginning the Gemini 3 era by releasing Gemini 3 Pro in preview and making it available today across a suite of Google products so you can use it in your daily life to learn, build and plan anything.
evidence.excerpt_text_normalization: consecutive whitespace collapsed to one space
evidence.claim_supported: The authored Google announcement explicitly identifies Gemini 3 Pro as the Gemini 3 preview release available that day. The inspected page heading reads “A new era of intelligence with Gemini 3 Nov 18, 2025”; its publication metadata also records 2025-11-18. In the paragraph specifically about Gemini 3 Pro, it states “It tops the LMArena Leaderboard with a breakthrough score of 1501 Elo.” The same dated article states “Today we’re releasing Google Antigravity , our new agentic development platform that enables developers to operate at a higher, task-oriented level.” and “While the core of Google Antigravity is a familiar AI IDE experience, its agents have been elevated to a dedicated surface and given direct access to the editor, terminal and browser.” These passages establish the Pro designation, preview-release date, and the LMArena/Antigravity context requested by catalog row 92.
limitations: The release is explicitly a preview; this evidence does not establish general-availability status.
This is Google’s dated first-party announcement, captured on 2026-09-13; it is not an independently archived November 2025 page snapshot.
The LMArena statement is Google’s reported standing at announcement time, not a separately inspected historical leaderboard.
The quoted support comes from the authored article body and visible date, not the page’s AI-generated summary.
